dedupe_keys.name: influence of dense granular columns on the performance of level and gently sloping liquefiable sites

description: Influence of Dense Granular Columns on the Performance of Level and Gently Sloping Liquefiable Sites is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Shideh Dashti, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This project presents the results of three centrifuge experiments that systematically evaluate the influence of dense granular columns and their various mitigation mechanisms and properties on the seismic performance of level and gently sloping sites underlain by a layered liquefiable deposit consisting mostly of clean sand. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-eqg9-dx70. Keywords: Granular columns, liquefaction, slope, stone columns, gravel columns. Published 2019-01-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
